title: Docker: Run Orchard Core in a Container | Orchard Core
description:
Orchard Core includes a Dockerfile in its source repository, but a container needs more than an image: a port to browse, a place for the files of the site, and a database.

This video builds an image from the Dockerfile, runs a container and opens its Setup screen, shows where the site keeps its data, and uses Docker Compose to start a PostgreSQL database next to the site.

In this video:
• What you need, and the two ways to get an image
• The Dockerfile and the .dockerignore file
• Building the image, running a container, and pruning intermediate images
• The first request: the Setup screen of a container
• The App_Data folder, volumes and environment variables
• Docker Compose with a PostgreSQL service
